items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The letter was served formally (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the delivery slip on page 2 shows it was handed over on 21.11.2026 (Saturday) — this actual service date is the anchor, not the statutory deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period starts 22.11.2026 and runs for two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) to 05.12.2026, a Saturday. Because the last day falls on a Saturday, § 193 BGB / § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO with § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO shift it to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the fine once the Bescheid is final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00.
items.computation: The Bescheid only becomes rechtskräftig (final) if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week period ending 07.12.2026; it becomes final the next day, 08.12.2026. Treating that as the anchor event, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes that day from the count, so the two-week payment period runs 09.12.2026 to 22.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 22.12.2026 is a Tuesday, a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date only holds if no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch replaces this payment obligation with the appeal procedure.

warnings: The payment deadline (22.12.2026) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026 and the fine becomes rechtskräftig on 08.12.2026 as assumed; filing an Einspruch in time removes this payment obligation — do not pay before that is clear.

Before transferring money, double-check that the IBAN (DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00) and the sender's contact details genuinely belong to Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle, e.g. via the city's official website, rather than relying solely on this letter.

The sender's email address printed on the letter ('bussgeld@stadt-musterquellen-bußgelds.example') has an unusual form (an extra word and the letter 'ß', which real domain names normally cannot contain); treat this as a cue to verify the sender independently before replying or paying.
